content.text:
Implemented the feature contract in django/contrib/admin/options.py.

Change: In ModelAdmin.changelist_view, the list_editable bulk-edit processing (the loop that saves each changed form via save_form/save_model/save_related/log_change) is now wrapped in `with transaction.atomic(using=router.db_for_write(self.model)):`. This ensures the view's database writes are atomic, so an error mid-processing rolls back all changes rather than leaving an inconsistent partial state. `transaction` and `router` were already imported.

Verification: scoped_tests public regression selection (admin_changelist) passed — 74 tests ran, 0 failures.
